caption.instagram:
A large sum lands in your account, from an inheritance, a bonus or a sale. Where does it go first?

Many people set it apart first, in its own account, while taxes and urgent bills are checked. Then they look at expensive debt, since paying it off stops the interest draining the pot; cash for surprise costs, called emergency savings; saving where tax is lower, usually up to a yearly limit; and the rest, spread across many investments rather than riding on one.

One sum, several jobs. Pause, then plan.
